record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace max-normalization of the existing log-frequency feature with normalization by the 95th percentile of log1p training counts over observed items, clipped to [0,1], then retain the square root. This reduces sensitivity to extreme head-item counts and tests stronger attenuation of common history items. Keep unseen-item and padding features zero. Preserve the existing input-scale formula, embeddings, backbone, readout, loss and optimizer; store the feature buffer in each category's single checkpoint.

category_rationales.rationale: Normalize log training counts by their 95th percentile over observed items, then clip and retain the square root. This tests stronger attenuation of common history items with less sensitivity to extreme counts. Padding and unseen-item features remain zero. The existing checkpoint buffer preserves predictor consistency; embeddings, backbone, readout, loss and optimizer remain fixed.
